title: Iressa visual presets
description: Appearance only. A preset is a combination of the generic shader effects (scale curve, colour curve, blebbing, fragments, transparency, emissive, nuclei). Adding a cause means adding a preset here and an entry in rules.json - never a shader change.

radiusFraction.description: Cell radius as a fraction of the voxel size.

detail.description: Icosphere subdivision: 0 is 20 triangles, 1 is 80, 2 is 320. Blebbing and fragmenting need at least 1; 2 is for close inspection of a small population and costs four times the vertices.

cloneColors.description: Keyed by clone id (as a string).

causeColors.description: Keyed by cause id (as a string). Used by the colour-by-cause view, the tally and the chart.

drugColors.description: Keyed by drug id (as a string). Presets with tintFrom=drug take their tint from here.

stateFallbackPresets.description: Preset used when a node is in a state with no active cause animation. Keyed by state id.

byEvent.description: Most specific override: keyed by "<eventType>:<causeId>", e.g. "5:4" for the state change a radiation hit causes versus "2:4" for the death it leads to.

byCause.description: Optional per-cause override of the animation named in rules.json. Keyed by cause id.

durationTicks.description: Simulated ticks the effect takes to reach phase 1. Phase clamps at 1, so a preset's phase-1 appearance is its resting appearance; make an effect transient with the "pulse" curve, `swell` or `flashTicks` instead.

scaleTarget.description: Radius multiplier at phase 1. <1 shrinks, >1 swells.

swell.description: Extra radius added mid-animation and released (an overshoot).

tintFrom.description: fixed uses tint; drug uses drugColors[event.drug]; clone uses cloneColors[event.newClone].

bleb.description: Surface displacement amplitude as a fraction of radius.

blebDrift.description: How fast the bleb pattern crawls over the animation.

fragments.description: Number of lobes the surface splits into.

fragmentSpread.description: How far lobes separate, as a fraction of radius.

nuclei.description: Visible internal lobes (multinucleation). Rendered as smooth bulges.

flashTicks.description: Length of the emissive flash at the start of the effect. 0 means emissive is steady.
